newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dacom Corp closes US$50 mln FRN.
newsitem.headline: Dacom Corp closes US$50 mln FRN.

text.p: Dacom Corp's US$50 million floating rate note issue has been allotted, lead manager Daiwa Securities said Monday.
The facility has a final maturity of five years. The issue was priced at 99.85 to float at 60 basis points over the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
With fees, the all-in return for top-tier managers is 65 basis points.
Daiwa Securities Hong Kong is lead manager.
Daewoo Securities is senior co-lead manager.
ABN Amro, Sanwa International Finance, Mitsui Trust Banking Co Ltd and WestLB are co-lead managers.
